name: OVR Technology
old_description: OVR has unlocked scent for video games with the Omara Scent Display.
about:
Based in Burlington, Vermont, OVR Technology develops hardware and software that add olfactory cues to interactive media. The company was founded by a team spanning industrial design, fragrance creation, neuroscience, and software engineering, though a founding year and ownership structure have not been publicly disclosed.

OVR’s core product line consists of the Omara Core and Omara Pro, personal scent displays that connect to PCs, mobile devices, and VR headsets via Wi‑Fi, Bluetooth, or USB. The Core model offers ten scent channels and a desktop form factor, while the Pro provides sixteen channels in a pocket‑sized unit. Both devices mix up to three scent channels simultaneously and deliver bursts or continuous streams, with a time‑to‑perception ranging from 500 to 1,000 milliseconds.

The technology targets video‑game players and creators, with explicit support for PC and VR titles. OVR also partners with independent studios worldwide to integrate scent into their games, providing a software development kit and scent‑cartridge system that lets developers trigger aromas in sync with gameplay events.

The company positions itself as a first mover in digital scent, emphasizing the difficulty of pioneering the category. Its stated differentiation rests on the integration of hardware, proprietary Scentware® cartridges, and a software layer that synchronizes scent release with real‑time game data.
